$comment: ACTS THAT HAVE NO ROUTE YET (GEN-055). The act-id vocabulary is the contract's POST operationIds (GEN-047 A1); an acts-only PID cannot register with canPerform under ids the contract does not carry, and inventing a second id namespace would be the second mechanism A1 forbids. So each act here is DECLARED with the PID that will route it, generate-act-operations.mjs folds them into the one type, and --check refuses an id that also appears as a route (it must be removed from here when it lands) — a debt with a creditor, the fixture-debt pattern.
